raw.summary: Primerica, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial products and services to middle-income households in the United States and Canada. It operates in three segments: Term Life Insurance; Investment and Savings Products; and Corporate and Other Distributed Products. The Term Life Insurance segment underwrites individual term life insurance products.
